meta.name: Crystal Bloom
meta.description: A cluster of huge crystal spires bursts up out of the ground and grows out in a fan, fast at first and then creeping to full length. The spires stay as real crystal: lasers bounce off them, blasts shatter them into shards and an undermined spire can snap off. A spire that grows into a tank skewers it and carries it up on its tip. Trees and houses are left whole; the spires grow around them.
